## Design

### 2026-10-09 – Log 1 -  (8/10/26)

**2.55h**

Log 1 -  (8/10/26)

Started working on project. Named it Starboy. Looked through the github repository, and some tutorials on KiCAD and for some reason CAD. Didn't know CAD was different.

Built the schematic for the Starboy. Had some difficulties in finding the Xiao ESP32 symbol and the required footprints. Then realized they could be imported.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FFpVYJGAQwzaBOsKrmKyHKKTZKhvPwY8/52707610cf19ce162730cea6c1defb177d5dd3301c5dd301c9b0b7b13847c2f5.png)
// image 1.

Really cool stuff. Had fun. Note to self for the future - do not dual tab KiCAD and Lapse. Will give you a split headache.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FFpVYJGAQwzaBOsKrmKyHKKTZKhvPwY8/02aa254adb30469c10022e6cbb1bc2a836cef56322617fde913742373a46192d.png)
// image 2

thus tl;dr, is that learnt about KiCAD and CAD(honest mistake). Finished the Schematic. Took longer than expected. Next up is the PCB routing.
